knowledge_checks.title: Active Recall: 2.2.4
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. For aX + bY: (1) write E[aX+bY]; (2) write Var(aX+bY) when X and Y may be dependent (include Cov).
hints: Use CMP language from today's notes.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: E[aX+bY] = a E[X] + b E[Y]. Var(aX+bY) = a² Var(X) + b² Var(Y) + 2ab Cov(X,Y) (Cov term vanishes if independent).
